title: Protocol for in vitro assessment of human monocyte transendothelial migration using a high-throughput live cell imaging system
protocol: Seed mKate2-N THP-1 cells in IncuCyte® ClearView 96-well chemotaxis cell migration plates at 5000 cells/well in 60 μL of HUVEC culture medium (full EGM-2 MV).
Determine the concentration of mKate2-N THP-1 cells in the culture by a dye exclusion procedure for viable cell counting.
Centrifuge twice the required number of cells at 120 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C, then remove supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in half the theoretical volume of full EGM-2 MV pre-warmed to 37°C.
Determine the total number of mKate2-N THP-1 cells by a dye exclusion procedure for viable cell counting.
Add full EGM-2 MV pre-warmed to 37°C to reach a final concentration of 8.33 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Store at 37°C until seeding in insert plates.
Rinse HUVEC monolayers with 60 μL of EGM-2 MV pre-warmed to 37°C and empty the wells.
Add 60 μL (5000 cells) of mKate2-N THP-1 cells per well.
Centrifuge plates at 50 × g for 3 min at 20°C–25°C to rapidly bring monocytes to the surface of the endothelial cell monolayer.
If centrifugation is not possible, allow mKate2-N THP-1 cells to settle on the endothelial monolayer at 20°C–25°C for 45–60 min.
Fill the wells of a new reservoir plate with 200 μL of full EGM-2 MV pre-warmed to 37°C and containing 100 nM of the chemoattractant MCP1.
Transfer the insert plate containing the cells into the new pre-filled reservoir plate containing full EGM-2 MV ± MCP1.
Leave a small volume of medium in the insert well when removing culture medium from insert plates to avoid touching and damaging HUVEC monolayers.
Change the medium two columns at a time to minimize cell exposure to air, which could result in damage or death.
Fill the wells with mKate2-N THP-1 cells using the same procedure as for HUVECs.
Launch real-time acquisitions with the IncuCyte® S3 live-cell analysis system and analyze the scans.
Place the IncuCyte® ClearView 96-well chemotaxis cell migration plates in the vessel tray of the IncuCyte® instrument, which is inside a Heracell 240i cell incubator.
Allow the plate to warm to 37°C for approximately 10 minutes.
Wipe away any condensation remaining on the outside of the cover plate if necessary.
In the chemotaxis module of the IncuCyte® software, schedule 24-hour scans every 30 minutes for one plate over a total time of 3 days.
Adjust the frequency of scans based on the number of plates: every hour for two plates or every two hours for four plates.
Record scans of the top and bottom sides of the permeable membrane in transmitted light and red fluorescence using an ×10 objective lens.
Adjust the exposure time for fluorescence intensity based on initial trials.
Maintain a constant temperature of 37°C inside the IncuCyte® S3 device.
Lower the cell incubator temperature to 35.8°C when scanning two plates every hour.
Perform phase and fluorescence scans with the IncuCyte® S3 instrument focused on the top surface of membranes.
Conduct fluorescence scans focused on the bottom of the membrane for monocytes that have passed through the endothelial layer.
Analyze transendothelial migration data acquired over time using the IncuCyte® S3 instrument.
Set appropriate segmentation parameters from scans of the bottom of the membranes for detecting fluorescent objects.
Exclude fluorescent THP-1 cells on top membranes from study.
Quantification of top fluorescent THP-1 is inaccurate due to high cell density and multiplication over time.
Track appearance of cells that have migrated through the endothelial cell monolayer using segmentation parameters.
Load the parameters of the pre-saved analysis in the Analysis Setup window for IncuCyte® software.
Perform the scan analysis using the IncuCyte® software (Chemotaxis Migration Top/Bot analysis).

Use segmentation parameters: for phase, set seed threshold at 50 and grow threshold at 100 with no clean-up and area and eccentricity filters off; for red fluorescence, use a seed threshold of 10-5, grow threshold of 50, edge sensitivity of 0, area filter from minimum 20 mm² to maximum 600 mm², eccentricity filter set at 0.78, mean intensity filter at 0.1 with no integrated intensity filter.
Export the data from IncuCyte® software after analysis.
Open graph data in analysis results for export consideration.
Select [Bottom] metrics, wells, and scans to be exported.
Export data from the selecting grouping menu as a text file.
Open the exported text file with Microsoft Excel.
Organize the data for statistical analysis in Microsoft Excel.
Import the organized data into GraphPad Prism.
Analyze and represent the data using visualization charts in GraphPad Prism.
Click on the Export Images and Movies icon in IncuCyte® software.
Choose “As Displayed” from the Export Type window.
Select one or more wells and choose Image Channel(s) and Channel Mask(s).
Select “Single Movie of Images as Displayed” for Sequence Type and Scans.
Adjust cropping and scaling, customize the movie, and choose frames per second in the Export Design window.
Export movies in MPEG-4 or AVI video file format.
